name: @yottameta/yotta-item
description: YuanTi (yotta-item) — a local, deterministic paper assembler and exam checker for AI agents: reads a local item bank (id, type, points, difficulty, knowledge, optional minutes and source) plus a blueprint (item types, knowledge coverage, difficulty quotas, points, time limit), assembles a paper whose selection is reproducible from a fixed seed, and checks an existing paper for unknown items, duplicates, section and points deviations, difficulty drift, coverage gaps and time overrun. Markdown and JSON output, input validation commands, and a CI gate are included. Triggers: assembling an exam paper from a local bank, selecting items against a double-spec table, checking whether a paper matches its blueprint, or wiring paper review into automation. Boundaries: selection and deterministic checking only — no item text or answer generation, no prediction of measured difficulty or discrimination, no student ranking, comments or admission predictions; no network access, no model calls, no upload of item banks or papers; no textbook or real-exam text is bundled, and samples are synthetic. Fully local, zero-dependency (Python 3.8+ standard library).
